simple.summary: אָפֵס (ʼâphêç) means to disappear , i.e. cease First listed occurrence: Gen 47 15.

definitions.usage: be clean gone (at an end, brought to nought), fail.
definitions.full: H656. aphes אָפֵס (compare מָּסַס ) verb cease, fail, come to an end : only Qal Perfect 3masculine singular; Gen 47:15-16 , (of money, כֶּסֶף ), Isa 16:4 (extortioner: || תַּם כָּלָה, ), 29:20 (terrible one: || נִכְרַת כָּלָה, ), Psa 77:9 ( חסְדּוֺ || גָּמַר ).
